prompts.neck: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved appearance reference, not a target to regenerate. Create ONE isolated production texture candidate: only the woman's neck skin, continuing behind the jaw at the top and behind the shirt collar at the bottom. This is for a high fidelity photographic Live2D puppet. Preserve her exact slender neck width, length, front-facing perspective, skin color, soft studio illumination and subtle natural throat/collarbone anatomy from the reference. Show the entire neck as a continuous clean form, with enough upper skin hidden behind the jaw and lower skin hidden behind the shirt. The visible central neck must closely match the reference. No head, face, chin, hair, blue strands, ears, shoulders, clothing, collar, tie, rectangular skin patches, hard internal seams or flat-color polygons. The neck should have smooth anatomically plausible sides, gently broaden at its lower root, and smoothly finished hidden top and bottom contour. Do not make a torso or bust. Photographic skin detail and very subtle natural shading, not painterly or plastic. Exactly one isolated neck piece centered on genuine transparent background, ample transparent margin. No text, labels, border, checkerboard drawing or multiple views. This is an unapproved part candidate; do not alter or recreate the approved full character.
prompts.neckEdgeTrial: Edit only the alpha boundary of this isolated neck texture. Preserve the existing neck interior skin, anatomy, lighting, color, proportions and placement exactly. Remove all yellow/red/white colored fringe pixels, isolated specks and ragged edge debris around the entire outline. Do not add any face, hair, clothes or other body parts, do not change neck width or texture, do not draw a background.
prompts.backHair: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input 1 is the approved photographic character appearance reference. Input 2 is an old combined hair cutout used only to identify the existing hair silhouette, color, length and strand direction; its face hole, skin/ear contamination and missing neck-edge hair are defects. Produce ONE clean rear-hair layer for this same character's Live2D model. This is the back bob hair mass, to be drawn BEHIND separate face, neck, ears, fringe and side-lock layers. Preserve the reference's vivid cobalt blue color, photographic fine strands, crown part, round short-bob outer silhouette, exact side volume and shoulder-length tips; do not invent a new haircut. Reconstruct the continuous hidden inner back-hair mass behind the face and neck, with natural darker blue depth and flowing strands. There must be no face-shaped transparent hole: this layer is continuous blue hair behind the occluding head. Separate foreground bangs and the thin front side-locks will be authored elsewhere: omit the wispy fringe lying on the forehead and omit all face/skin/ears/neck/clothing/background. Retain only hair in this single rear-hair layer. Complete the lower inner hair edges smoothly behind the neck instead of polygonal notches, white tips or disconnected strips. Match original outer outline, not a generic wig. Front-facing orthographic photographic texture, no perspective change. Show the entire single rear hair form centered with margin on genuine transparent background. No labels, no diagram, no multiple variants. This is a component candidate only, not a replacement or regeneration of the approved character image.
